title: System memories are resolvable as entities but absent from the searchable corpus and schema counts
wanted_capability: sm-* system memories retrievable through bbox_hybrid_search and counted in bbox_describe_schema. SystemMemoryProvider (crates/bbox-providers/src/providers/system_memory.rs) now resolves system_memory refs for inspect from the loaded catalog, but no indexer writes system_memory docs (no system_memory doc_type anywhere in crates/bbox-corpus-index), so hybrid search never returns them, and describe_schema's population_count stays 0 because complete_schema_counts (src/server/schema.rs) seeds counts for transcript, knowledge, thread, note, whiteboard, brofile and agent but not system_memory. sm-* content is reachable only through bbox_knowledge catalog lookup, and eval/queries/cross-modal-notes-side-channel.json (expects system_memory:sm-side-channel-notes, pass_strictness=all) is structurally unpassable.
fallback_used: bbox_knowledge catalog lookup remains the only retrieval path for sm-* content
